summary.text: Daniel Gibson is a Republican commercial pilot who has represented District 12 in the South Carolina House of Representatives since November 14, 2022, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Daniel Gibson was born in Anderson, South Carolina, and lives in Greenwood.
Gibson earned an A.S. from Forrest College in 1975, and his career experience includes work as a commercial pilot.
Gibson succeeded J. Anne Parks as the District 12 representative.
He is assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee for 2025-2026.
